what.text: This page follows refugees from Mali in all host countries combined.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 519738 Malian refugees, and Mauritania hosts the largest share, 57.8%.
Niger and Burkina Faso are the next largest hosts.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Mali from 2012 to 2025, at war level in 2022 and 2025.
The groups fighting the government over that time include Ansar Dine, AQIM, MUJAO and JNIM.
UCDP also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2017 to 2025, and over the government and Azawad territory with the FLA from 2023 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's figure rose from 354075 at the end of 2024 to 519738 at the end of 2025, its highest.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2024 and 2025; there were earlier big changes in the 1990s and from 2006 to 2012.
Returns to Mali were highest in 1995 in UNHCR's returns data.

how.text: These are year-end totals of refugees; asylum seekers from Mali are counted in a separate series.
People displaced inside Mali are counted separately by UNHCR and by IDMC, and their figures are never added.
The sources don't say which routes people took.
